note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received on 7 May 1936. Only one new member, Mr. James Coey, was nominated; there was no change in the other seven divisions, the sitting members being returned unopposed. Polling in County Antrim was fixed for 28 May 1936. Filed on 1936-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Antrim that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
